default.$description: The primary brand colour, for brand fills, marks and accents.

subtle.$description: Light tint of the primary brand colour, for quiet brand fills.

strong.$description: Deep shade of the primary brand colour, for text and marks on its light tint.

default.$description: The secondary brand colour, for brand fills, marks and accents.

subtle.$description: Light tint of the secondary brand colour, for quiet brand fills.

strong.$description: Deep shade of the secondary brand colour, for text and marks on its light tint.

default.$description: The tertiary brand colour, for brand fills, marks and accents.

subtle.$description: Light tint of the tertiary brand colour, for quiet brand fills.

strong.$description: Deep shade of the tertiary brand colour, for text and marks on its light tint.

default.$description: Base surface of the page and of the cards on it.

sunken.$description: Recessed surface below the page, such as the fill of filled fields.

subtle.$description: Quiet surface one step off the page, for low-emphasis areas and hover fills.

inverse.$description: Surface in the opposite tone of the page, for inverted regions and solid neutral marks.

brand-primary.$description: Surface filled with the primary brand colour, for promotional or emphasized regions.

overlay.$description: Dimming layer that covers the page behind a modal layer.

tint.$description: Translucent wash over any surface that signals hover, drag or selection.

transparent.$description: No fill, for parts that take up space but paint nothing.

primary.$description: Main text, such as body copy and headings, with the highest contrast on its surface.

secondary.$description: Supporting text, such as field labels and secondary copy.

muted.$description: Quietest readable text, for helper text and hints.

brand.$description: Text in the primary brand colour, for brand-tinted copy that is not a link.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text in an empty field.

subtle.$description: Quiet border, for the outlines of containers and overlays and for dividers.

stronger.$description: Strongest border, for the outlines of controls under the pointer or pressed.

strong.$description: Strong border, for the outlines of controls at rest.

default.$description: Default border, for neutral outlines and separators.

base.$description: Strong success colour, for success fills, text, icons and outlines.

subtle.$description: Light success colour, for quiet success fills.

on-base.$description: Text and icons on the strong success colour.

base.$description: Strong information colour, for information fills, text, icons and outlines.

subtle.$description: Light information colour, for quiet information fills.

on-base.$description: Text and icons on the strong information colour.

base.$description: Strong warning colour, for warning fills, text, icons and outlines.

subtle.$description: Light warning colour, for quiet warning fills.

on-base.$description: Text and icons on the strong warning colour.

base.$description: Strong error colour, for error fills, text, icons and outlines.

subtle.$description: Light error colour, for quiet error fills.

on-base.$description: Text and icons on the strong error colour.

default.$description: Fill of a primary action at rest.

hover.$description: Fill of a primary action under the pointer.

active.$description: Fill of a primary action while pressed.

default.$description: Text and icons on a primary action at rest.

hover.$description: Text and icons on a primary action under the pointer.

default.$description: Fill of a secondary action at rest.

hover.$description: Fill of a secondary action under the pointer.

default.$description: Text and icons on a secondary action at rest.

hover.$description: Text and icons on a secondary action under the pointer.

default.$description: Fill of a destructive action at rest.

hover.$description: Fill of a destructive action under the pointer.

default.$description: Text and icons on a destructive action at rest.

hover.$description: Text and icons on a destructive action under the pointer.

default.$description: Default colour of icons that stand on their own, without text.

background.$description: Fill and outline of a disabled control.

text.$description: Text and icons of a disabled control. Exempt from contrast requirements.
